name: Heat Shield Panel
description: Thermal protection tile that shields the orbiter hull from extreme heat during atmospheric re-entry. Must be replaced after severe temperature anomalies.

name: O2 Sensor Module
description: Monitors cabin oxygen concentration. Replaced when oxygenLevel sensor falls below safe thresholds to ensure crew life support integrity.

name: Coolant Pressure Valve
description: Regulates coolant flow through the orbiter's thermal control system. Required when coolantPressure drops below minimum operating level.

name: SRB Nozzle Assembly
description: Directs exhaust from the solid rocket booster to generate thrust. Inspected and replaced when casingTemperature or thrust readings deviate from nominal.

name: Vibration Damper
description: Absorbs mechanical vibrations from the solid rocket booster during ignition and ascent. Replaced when vibration sensor exceeds safe limits.

name: Fuel Tank Liner
description: Insulating liner inside the external tank that prevents cryogenic fuel from warming. Inspected after every flight for cracks or stress deformation.

name: Cryogenic Seal
description: High-performance seal for cryogenic fuel connections. Required when stress or fuelPressure readings indicate structural fatigue in the external tank.
